Title: LSJ : Muddled Vampire Hunter + Sengir Dagger

Messages.Author: Chris
Messages.Body: Does an MVH with Sengir dagger hit for 4 aggravated damage or just one?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <684u74$jk3$1...@pinah.connect.com.au>, Chris
<beb...@newave.net> writes

>Does an MVH with Sengir dagger hit for 4 aggravated damage or just one?
>
>
>

I'm not LSJ but...

On the *V:TES* version of MVH, he has 4 hand damage. This over-rides
the "4 damage" text on the Jyhad version. Since with a Sengir Dagger he
inflicts aggro damage equal to his hand damage which is now 4.

Thus with a Sengir Dagger, MVH hits for 4 aggro damage.

--

Correct. The Jyhad version's strike is a hand strike as well, under the
definition of a hand strike. So this answer applies to the Jyhad text.
